headline: Ranking for the brand name and nothing anyone searches before buying
leak: Non-paid traffic was 94% branded. The site had no page for what people type before they know who to buy from.
sub: Four service pages written to search intent instead of word count. The compounding started in month three.
steps: Month three shown flat, with the reason.
miss: Months one and two moved nothing, and we had not set that expectation hard enough.
